# ractermx_zone_record (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone record for a RacterMX-hosted domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage DNS zone records for a RacterMX-hosted domain.

# Create an A record pointing to a web server.
resource "ractermx_zone_record" "web" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
  name      = "www"
  type      = "A"
  content   = "203.0.113.10"
  ttl       = 3600
}

# Create an MX record for mail delivery.
resource "ractermx_zone_record" "mx" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
  name      = "@"
  type      = "MX"
  content   = "mail.example.com"
  ttl       = 3600
  priority  = 10
}

resource "ractermx_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The record content/value.
- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) The record name (e.g., 'www', '@', 'mail.example.com').
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds (60-86400).
- `type` (String) The record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, NS, CAA, etc.).

### Optional

- `port` (Number) Port (1-65535, for SRV records).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (0-65535, for MX/SRV records).
- `weight` (Number) Weight (0-65535, for SRV records).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite ID of the zone record in the format {domain_id}/{name}/{type}/{content}.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a zone record using the composite key format: {domain_id}/{name}/{type}/{content}
terraform import ractermx_zone_record.web 123/www/A/203.0.113.10
```
